title: Live, Love, LASSO
body:
Suppose we want to fit an OLS model with $$p$$ features and an intercept. Call this Model A. For each proposed change to Model A below, select all possible effects on four measures: (model bias) squared, model variance, MSE on the training data, and MSE on held-out test data.
• For each measure, select Increase, Decrease, or both. At least one option will always apply.
• For each measure, the effects you select do not have to be guaranteed, they just have to be possible.
• For each proposed change, you should assume there are no changes to the model except for the proposed change.
• You should assume that the data-generating process does not change, and that the model fitting process always converges.
• You do not have to consider whether the proposed change has no effect on the measure, though it may be possible.
